items.name: Salvage Cleaver
items.description: A truck spring ground to a brutal edge.

items.name: Pipe Pistol
items.description: Crude, concealable, and barely trustworthy.

items.name: Shock Probe
items.description: A diagnostic wand rewired to stun living targets.

items.name: Wrecking Bar
items.description: Heavy steel for doors, debris, and skulls.

items.name: Holdout Revolver
items.description: Five chambers and the authority to end an argument.

items.name: Rusted Hatchet
items.description: A camp tool that has outlived several camps.

items.name: Rebar Spear
items.description: Reach is often worth more than refinement.

items.name: Nail Bat
items.description: Simple, loud, and intimidating.

items.name: Hunting Rifle
items.description: Accurate at distance if you can feed it ammunition.

items.name: Scrap Shotgun
items.description: A close-range answer assembled from old plumbing.

items.name: Stun Baton
items.description: A security baton with a weak but useful charge.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.description: A signaling tool that changes minds at close range.

items.name: Scrap Vest
items.description: Sheet-metal scales sewn onto old canvas.

items.name: Runner Jacket
items.description: Light protection with room to move.

items.name: Plated Coat
items.description: Hidden plates make it heavy and dependable.

items.name: Dust Cloak
items.description: Waxed fabric that keeps ash out of the lungs.

items.name: Tire Armor
items.description: Rubber slabs turn blades but trap heat.

items.name: Riot Padding
items.description: Faded public-order gear from the final evacuation.

items.name: Hazmat Wrap
items.description: Mismatched polymer sheets with sealed seams.

items.name: Scout Leathers
items.description: Quiet layers reinforced at the joints.

items.name: Scrap Buckler
items.description: A road-sign disc braced with a leather grip. It trades a little freedom of movement for a reliable guard.

items.name: Road Shield
items.description: A reinforced barrier plate with a grip salvaged from a security door. Too cumbersome to move around quickly.

items.name: Field Scanner
items.description: Maps heat, current, and weak radiation sources.

items.name: Trader Token
items.description: An old market seal recognized along the road.

items.name: Lucky Die
items.description: A rounded bone die whose six is almost worn away.

items.name: Filter Mask
items.description: A repaired respirator with one clean cartridge.

items.name: Signal Compass
items.description: A needle that points toward active transmitters.

items.name: Mechanic Gloves
items.description: Insulated gloves with magnetic fingertips.

items.name: Canvas Pack
items.description: Patched, plain, and better than empty hands.

items.name: Frame Pack
items.description: An aluminum hiking frame with new straps.

items.name: Medic Satchel
items.description: Organized pockets make treatment easier under pressure.

items.name: Scavenger Rig
items.description: Harness loops spread awkward salvage across the body.

items.name: Canned Meat
items.description: Unlabeled protein in a dented tin.
items.use_text: You eat slowly and keep the grease off your gear. Satiety +2.

items.name: Clean Water
items.description: A sealed bottle with no visible sediment.
items.use_text: The clean water steadies you. Fatigue -8.

items.name: Cloth Bandage
items.description: Boiled cloth wrapped in wax paper.
items.use_text: You clean and bind the damaged skin. HP +30; Bleeding and Burns treated when present.

items.name: Field Medkit
items.description: Real antiseptic and sealed sutures.
items.use_text: You use the scarce medical supplies. HP +75; wounds, infection, concussion, and burns treated when present.

items.name: Rad Tabs
items.description: Chalky pills from a civil-defense packet.
items.use_text: The tablets leave a metallic taste. Radiation -18.

items.name: Stimulant Injector
items.description: Borrowed energy with tomorrow's interest.
items.use_text: Your hands steady as your pulse climbs. Fatigue -30, HP -10; Exhaustion is suppressed and Steady Hands lasts for two checks.

items.name: Ration Bar
items.description: Dense emergency food that tastes of cardboard.
items.use_text: The ration is dry but dependable. Satiety +1, Fatigue -4.

items.name: Bitter Tonic
items.description: A herbal brew traded by marsh walkers.
items.use_text: The bitter tonic settles fever and shaking when present. HP +20, Radiation -5.

items.name: Purifier Ampoule
items.description: An injector designed for acute contamination.
items.use_text: The treatment burns through your veins. Radiation -35, HP -10; Irradiation is treated when present.

items.name: Painkillers
items.description: Three tablets in a cracked orange bottle.
items.use_text: The pain becomes distant enough to move. HP +15, Fatigue -12; sprains and concussion are treated when present.

items.name: Glow Moss
items.description: A faintly luminous fungus that scavengers chew in emergencies.
items.use_text: It fills your stomach and warms your teeth. Satiety +1, Radiation +5.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
items.description: Fertilizer, sugar, and a short fuse.
items.use_text: This item is consumed by specific escape choices.

items.name: Pistol Rounds
items.description: Mixed small-caliber cartridges.

items.name: Revolver Rounds
items.description: Heavy cartridges wrapped against moisture.

items.name: Rifle Rounds
items.description: Long cartridges worth more than most meals.

items.name: Shotgun Shells
items.description: Hand-loaded shells with uncertain shot.

items.name: Scrap Parts
items.description: Wire, fasteners, and useful bits of metal.

items.name: Climbing Rope
items.description: Ten meters of faded but serviceable rope.
